SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.category AS category, m.name, m.address, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.review_id) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE COALESCE(m.rating, 0.0) END AS rating, COALESCE(COUNT(r.review_id), 0) AS review_count, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bookmarks b WHERE b.users_id = #{userId} AND b.merchants_id = m.id AND b.is_deleted IS NULL ) AS bookmarked FROM merchants m LEFT JOIN tourism_merchant_sources tms ON tms.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN accommodations a ON a.merchant_id = m.id AND m.category = 'ACCOMMODATION' LEFT JOIN offices o ON o.merchant_id = m.id AND m.category = 'OFFICE' LEFT JOIN restaurants rt ON rt.merchant_id = m.id AND m.category = 'RESTAURANT' LEFT JOIN activities ac ON ac.merchant_id = m.id AND m.category = 'ACTIVITY' LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.merchant_id = m.id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE (tms.merchant_id IS NULL OR tms.is_active = 1)
AND m.category = 'ACCOMMODATION' AND a.merchant_id IS NOT NULL
AND m.category = 'OFFICE' AND o.merchant_id IS NOT NULL
AND m.category = 'RESTAURANT' AND rt.merchant_id IS NOT NULL
AND m.category = 'ACTIVITY' AND ac.merchant_id IS NOT NULL
AND ( ( m.category = 'ACCOMMODATION' AND a.merchant_id IS NOT NULL ) OR ( m.category = 'OFFICE' AND o.merchant_id IS NOT NULL ) OR ( m.category = 'RESTAURANT' AND rt.merchant_id IS NOT NULL ) OR ( m.category = 'ACTIVITY' AND ac.merchant_id IS NOT NULL ) )
AND m.region_id = #{regionId}
AND m.price >= #{minPrice}
AND m.price <= #{maxPrice}
AND ( m.category NOT IN ('ACCOMMODATION', 'OFFICE') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM reservation_products rp INNER JOIN product_daily_inventories pdi ON pdi.product_id = rp.id WHERE rp.merchant_id = m.id AND ( ( m.category = 'ACCOMMODATION' AND rp.product_detail_type = 'ROOM'
AND rp.max_headcount * #{roomCount} >= #{headcount}
) OR ( m.category = 'OFFICE' AND rp.product_detail_type IN ('OFFICE_SEAT', 'MEETING_ROOM')
AND (
( rp.product_detail_type = 'OFFICE_SEAT' AND pdi.remaining_capacity >= #{headcount} ) OR ( rp.product_detail_type != 'OFFICE_SEAT' AND rp.max_headcount >= #{headcount} AND pdi.remaining_capacity > 0 ) )
) ) AND pdi.inventory_date >= #{checkInDate} AND ( (m.category = 'ACCOMMODATION' AND pdi.inventory_date < #{checkOutDate}) OR (m.category = 'OFFICE' AND pdi.inventory_date <= #{checkOutDate}) ) GROUP BY rp.id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pdi.inventory_date) = CASE WHEN m.category = 'ACCOMMODATION' THEN #{requiredDateCount} WHEN m.category = 'OFFICE' THEN #{requiredDateCount} + 1 END AND MIN(CASE WHEN pdi.is_available = 1 AND pdi.remaining_capacity > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pdi.inventory_date) = CASE WHEN m.category = 'ACCOMMODATION' THEN #{requiredDateCount} WHEN m.category = 'OFFICE' THEN #{requiredDateCount} + 1 END AND MIN(CASE WHEN pdi.is_available = 1 AND (
(m.category = 'ACCOMMODATION' AND pdi.remaining_capacity >= #{roomCount}) OR (m.category = 'OFFICE' AND ( (rp.product_detail_type = 'OFFICE_SEAT' AND pdi.remaining_capacity >= #{headcount}) OR (rp.product_detail_type != 'OFFICE_SEAT' AND rp.max_headcount >= #{headcount} AND pdi.remaining_capacity > 0) ) ) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
) )
AND (m.category <> 'ACCOMMODATION' OR a.accommodation_type = #{accommodationType})
AND (m.category <> 'OFFICE' OR o.noise_level = #{noiseLevel})
AND (m.category <> 'RESTAURANT' OR rt.food_type = #{foodType})
AND (m.category <> 'RESTAURANT' OR rt.price_level <= #{priceLevel})
AND (m.category <> 'ACTIVITY' OR ac.activity_type = #{activityType})
AND (m.price > #{cursorValue} OR (m.price = #{cursorValue} AND m.id > #{cursorMerchantId}))
AND (m.price < #{cursorValue} OR (m.price = #{cursorValue} AND m.id < #{cursorMerchantId}))
AND (m.rating < #{cursorValue} OR (m.rating = #{cursorValue} AND m.id < #{cursorMerchantId}))
GROUP BY m.id, m.category, m.name, m.address, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, m.rating
ORDER BY m.price ASC, m.id ASC
ORDER BY m.price DESC, m.id DESC
ORDER BY m.rating DESC, m.id DESC
LIMIT #{size}

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.region_id, m.name, m.address, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.phone_number, a.accommodation_type, a.description, a.check_in_time, a.check_out_time, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM reviews r WHERE r.merchant_id = m.id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' ) THEN COALESCE(m.rating, 0.0) ELSE 0.0 END AS rating, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bookmarks b WHERE b.users_id = #{userId} AND b.merchants_id = m.id AND b.is_deleted IS NULL ) AS bookmarked FROM merchants m JOIN accommodations a ON a.merchant_id = m.id WHERE m.id = #{merchantId} AND m.category = 'ACCOMMODATION'

SELECT rp.id AS product_id, rp.product_name, rp.description, rp.product_detail_type, rp.max_headcount, rp.unit_price, rp.thumbnail_url FROM reservation_products rp WHERE rp.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND rp.product_detail_type = 'ROOM' ORDER BY rp.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews r WHERE r.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT rp.id AS product_id, rp.product_name, rp.description, rp.product_detail_type, rp.max_headcount, rp.unit_price, rp.thumbnail_url FROM reservation_products rp INNER JOIN offices o ON o.merchant_id = #{merchantId} WHERE rp.merchant_id = o.merchant_id AND rp.product_detail_type IN ('OFFICE_SEAT', 'MEETING_ROOM') ORDER BY rp.id ASC

SELECT rp.id AS product_id, rp.product_name, rp.description, rp.product_detail_type, rp.max_headcount, rp.unit_price, rp.thumbnail_url FROM reservation_products rp INNER JOIN offices o ON o.merchant_id = #{merchantId}
INNER JOIN product_daily_inventories pdi ON pdi.product_id = rp.id
WHERE rp.merchant_id = o.merchant_id AND rp.product_detail_type IN ('OFFICE_SEAT', 'MEETING_ROOM')
AND ( rp.product_detail_type = 'OFFICE_SEAT' OR rp.max_headcount >= #{headcount} )
AND pdi.inventory_date >= #{startDate} AND pdi.inventory_date <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY rp.id, rp.product_name, rp.description, rp.product_detail_type, rp.max_headcount, rp.unit_price, rp.thumbnail_url HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pdi.inventory_date) = #{requiredDateCount} AND MIN(CASE WHEN pdi.is_available = 1 AND ( (rp.product_detail_type = 'OFFICE_SEAT' AND pdi.remaining_capacity >= #{headcount}) OR (rp.product_detail_type = 'MEETING_ROOM' AND pdi.remaining_capacity >= #{requiredQuantity}) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
ORDER BY rp.id ASC

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.name, m.address, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.phone_number, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.review_id) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE COALESCE(m.rating, 0.0) END AS rating, COALESCE(COUNT(r.review_id), 0) AS review_count, o.description, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bookmarks b WHERE b.users_id = #{userId} AND b.merchants_id = m.id AND b.is_deleted IS NULL ) AS bookmarked FROM merchants m INNER JOIN offices o ON o.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.merchant_id = m.id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE m.id = #{merchantId} AND m.category = 'OFFICE' GROUP BY m.id, m.name, m.address, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.phone_number, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, m.rating, o.description

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.region_id, m.name, m.address, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.phone_number, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.review_id) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE COALESCE(m.rating, 0.0) END AS rating, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, COALESCE(COUNT(r.review_id), 0) AS review_count, r2.description, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bookmarks b WHERE b.users_id = #{userId} AND b.merchants_id = m.id AND b.is_deleted IS NULL ) AS bookmarked FROM merchants m INNER JOIN restaurants r2 ON r2.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.merchant_id = m.id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE m.id = #{merchantId} AND m.category = 'RESTAURANT' GROUP BY m.id, m.region_id, m.name, m.address, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.phone_number, m.rating, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, r2.description

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.region_id, m.name, m.address, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.phone_number, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.review_id) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE COALESCE(m.rating, 0.0) END AS rating, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, COALESCE(COUNT(r.review_id), 0) AS review_count, a.description, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bookmarks b WHERE b.users_id = #{userId} AND b.merchants_id = m.id AND b.is_deleted IS NULL ) AS bookmarked FROM merchants m INNER JOIN activities a ON a.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.merchant_id = m.id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE m.id = #{merchantId} AND m.category = 'ACTIVITY' GROUP BY m.id, m.region_id, m.name, m.address, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.phone_number, m.rating, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, a.description
